trust_scale.note: Stored as trust.<npc_id> for npcs[] only. >=3 friendly, >=6 loyal, <=-3 hostile, <=-6 acts against Braith. Ambient NPCs and traders use flags (lusk_rep, trader_<id>_rep), not trust.

npcs.name: Carly Redmond
npcs.role: Braith's girlfriend. Washoe County 911 dispatcher; registry clerk (Ch2–5); founder of the Switchboard radio relay (Ch6+); runs intake and the census.
npcs.personality: Fast, precise, funny a second after bad news. Grew up in foster care in Reno; the valley's people are her family. Allergic to being protected.
npcs.voice: Triage cadence: 'Address? Breathing? Okay.' Calls Braith by name when serious, 'babe' when not. Dark one-liners.
npcs.motives: Make the count honest. Write every name down so it happened. Keep Braith from becoming a man who decides who's worth heat.
npcs.secret: She copied Avila's real stores sheets in Ch3 and kept them. In Ch6 she chooses the Switchboard's side with or without Braith.

relationship_effects.when: Let her choose the Switchboard's side

fates.outcome: Keeps the census board on the turbine hall wall.
Leaves Braith at the end of Ch6 (trust.carly<=-3); runs the Switchboard for her chosen faction; sits at its table in Ch10. Never dies in a scripted beat.
Walks south beside Braith, writing names in a notebook.

npcs.name: Wraith
npcs.role: Belgian Malinois. Military working dog washout ('too soft on the bite'). Braith's companion.
npcs.personality: Intense, bright, a little neurotic. Loves Wes's dirt bike, hates loudspeakers. Sees the Tallmen first and will not fight them.
npcs.voice: Non-verbal. Lines are bracketed action text: '[Ears up. One sharp bark.]'
npcs.motives: Stay with Braith. Keep the pack together.

relationship_effects.when: Feed her first when food is short
Order GUARD during the Ch6 sweep (gets her injured)

fates.outcome: Dies holding the line on the river ice in Ch9. ONLY path to wraith_alive=false; requires wraith_injured and an explicit, confirmed order.
Leads the column through the Ch9 whiteout to Galena by the smell of sulfur.
Sleeps against the warmest wall in the world.

npcs.name: Ross Pearce
npcs.role: Braith's father. Hay rancher, Yerington (Mason Valley). Widower. Lahontan Compact lieutenant under Ander.
npcs.personality: Stubborn, proud, decent; says less than he means. Keeps the radio on all night.
npcs.voice: Short rancher sentences. Writes on feed receipts. Calls Braith 'son' only when it matters.
npcs.motives: Keep the ranch and the valley fed. Get his sons home.
npcs.secret: He left the Day 0 voicemail meaning to say 'before I lose you too.' He blames himself for the fight that drove Braith away.
npcs.where_met: Voicemail Ch1; loc_i80_blockade, Ch5; loc_us50_fallon, Ch7

relationship_effects.when: Carry Wes to the Compact medics (Ch5)
Tell him what's in the Annex (annex_told=compact)

fates.outcome: Sends seed hay on the spring sled; letters signed 'Dad'.
Alive, distant. One-line letters.
Dies in Fallon in the second winter (annex not shared and the Compact starving).

npcs.name: Wes Pearce
npcs.role: Braith's younger brother. Compact rider. Wounded at the Ch5 blockade.
npcs.personality: Funny, reckless, loyal, idolizes Braith and resents him for leaving the ranch.
npcs.voice: Loud, all caps when excited. 'BIG BROTHER.' Jokes through pain.
npcs.motives: Make Dad proud. Be part of something. Not be the little brother forever.
npcs.secret: He's scared of the city and of being useless with a bad leg.

relationship_effects.when: Treat him and take him with you (wes_spared)

fates.outcome: Marches with the column in Ch9; the ice-break choice may cost him.
Lost under the river ice in Ch9 when Braith grabbed the sled.
If he was a prisoner, freed from the Remnant's MRAP in Ch10.

npcs.name: Dolores 'Lolo' Arrieta
npcs.role: Next-door neighbor. Retired ICU nurse. Runs a kitchen-table clinic. Basque family from Winnemucca.
npcs.personality: Warm and unbendable. Has done triage before and knows what it costs. Laughs at the worst moments.
npcs.voice: Calls everyone 'maitia' (Basque: dear). Ends hard truths with a soft question.
npcs.motives: Keep the block alive as a block. Never let anyone die alone in a hallway.
npcs.secret: Keeps a notebook of patients she has 'helped go' with clinic morphine, and an 'if it comes to it' page. In Ch8 Wes is on it if he's with you, wounded.

relationship_effects.when: Give the gas can for Mr. Pruitt
Hide her morphine in the sweep

fates.outcome: Runs Galena's infirmary. Burns the list.
Uses the last morphine on herself, with a note to Braith.

npcs.name: Gil Shumway
npcs.role: Neighbor across the alley. Retired Union Pacific diesel mechanic. Generator and six jugs of diesel.
npcs.personality: Prickly, practical, generous only when nobody's looking. Respects anyone who can fix things.
npcs.motives: Be ready when the help runs out. His pension is the diesel.
npcs.secret: He siphoned the diesel from a dead Maverik station on Day 1.

relationship_effects.when: Go in for him during the fire

fates.outcome: Burned in the Ch3 fire with no help; dies at end of Ch6.
Runs Galena's diesel backup. Complains constantly.

npcs.name: Kit Darrow
npcs.role: Scavenger and runner for the Viaduct Crew. Trades meds and rumors.
npcs.personality: Quick, funny, scared underneath. Pays her debts. Keeps count of favors.
npcs.voice: Fast patter, nicknames ('Wrench', 'the wolf'), deflects with jokes.
npcs.motives: Keep the Viaduct kids alive. Never owe anyone.
npcs.secret: She scouted Gil's garage for the raid in Ch3, paid in soup.
npcs.where_met: loc_prater_pharmacy, looting it at dusk, Ch1

relationship_effects.when: Let her go in the pharmacy
Cover for her in the line

fates.outcome: Dies in the Ch6 crackdown if trust.kit<3, or under the ice in Ch9.
Her voice on a stolen radio is the last thing you hear.

npcs.name: Capt. Lorna Avila
npcs.role: Nevada Army National Guard. Runs the Truckee Meadows Recovery Authority.
npcs.personality: Crisp, exhausted, competent. Believes order is mercy. Lies to prevent panic and hates herself for it.
npcs.voice: Clipped command voice. Numbers. 'It's not a crime. It's a count.'
npcs.motives: Keep the valley from starving all at once.
npcs.secret: The stores count is falsified: 41 days, not 140.

relationship_effects.when: Push her to break with Ironwood

fates.outcome: Runs Galena from an honest list of 412 names.
Killed in the Ch6 fighting (convoy sabotaged and trench blocked).

npcs.name: Augie Bell
npcs.role: Ham radio operator on Peavine Peak (KK7AUG). The valley's only news.
npcs.personality: Garrulous, kind, a showman. Invents good news on purpose.
npcs.voice: Radio patter: 'This is KK7AUG, still here.' Calls Braith 'my ears in Sparks.'
npcs.motives: Keep people listening. Hope is a public service.
npcs.secret: Half his good news is made up.

fates.outcome: Stays on Peavine when your people winter at Galena with trust<3; the shack goes silent in Act III.

npcs.name: Walt Okada
npcs.role: Ran Galena Station's control room for 22 years. Knows the black-start and the well field.
npcs.personality: Dry, patient, dying. Loves the plant more than most people.
npcs.voice: Slow, technical, affectionate about machines. 'That's the only good sound left in the world.'
npcs.motives: Hear the turbine run one more time. Hand the plant to someone who'll respect it.
npcs.secret: His lungs are failing from forty years of hydrogen sulfide; he won't see spring.

fates.outcome: Dies at Galena's control room window in Ch9 as the turbine spins up.

npcs.name: Dr. Samuel Ames
npcs.role: Last attending physician at Truckee Meadows General.
npcs.voice: Dry, rapid. 'If you're not bleeding, you're in the wrong building.'
npcs.motives: Keep the hospital open one more day.
npcs.secret: He trades hospital supplies to the Viaduct Crew for diesel.

relationship_effects.when: First Galena power to the hospital

fates.outcome: Runs the Galena-heated ward.

npcs.name: Roz Tafoya
npcs.role: Head chef and union steward at the Silver Spur. Leads the Floor.
npcs.personality: Loud, generous, ruthless about logistics. Feeds 3,000 a day.
npcs.secret: The Floor trades casino stock and food for guns.

relationship_effects.when: First Galena power to the Floor

fates.outcome: Runs the council's kitchens.

npcs.name: Ander Etcheverry
npcs.role: Basque sheep rancher from Fallon. Leader of the Lahontan Compact.
npcs.personality: Measured, devout, a born organizer. Right about the Directive and knows the cost of his blockade.
npcs.voice: Slow, preacher cadence. Asks questions instead of giving orders.
npcs.motives: Keep Nevada's food in Nevada. Keep his people alive.
npcs.secret: His blockade is starving his own aunt's care home in Sparks.

fates.outcome: Takes Galena's turbines east to the Stillwater field.

npcs.name: Sgt. Nadia Ruiz
npcs.role: Combat engineer, Task Force Ironwood (US Army). Call sign 'Engineer Two'. Defectable soldier.
npcs.personality: Practical, honest, tired. Follows the orders she can live with.
npcs.motives: Fix things instead of shooting them. Get her people home.
npcs.secret: She marks kids' houses clear on the sweep lists with two pencil dots. She saw a Tallman in Ch6 and logged it as 'animal'.

relationship_effects.when: Lever the MRAP door off her (ruiz_spared)
Treat Wes in front of her

fates.outcome: Joins Braith in Ch7; talks down the recovery detail; finds the Ch9 picket gap; enables a clean Dark Water demolition.

npcs.name: Dr. Hollis Reyne
npcs.role: Biologist, Dixie Valley Annex (contractor, Level 3 clearance). LONG SLEEP program, Wing A.
npcs.personality: Clinical, guilty, brave in small ways. Named the subjects she wasn't supposed to name.
npcs.voice: Precise, quiet, scientific vocabulary that cracks under feeling.
npcs.motives: Make it right, or at least help carry what it costs.
npcs.secret: She opened the Annex's outer door on Day 16 to get out and did not close it. She never had clearance for Wing B and does not know how many were held there.

fates.outcome: Runs the lamp line's night watch; predicts where they'll test.
Returns to the Annex to keep Tolliver company.

minor_characters.name: Mr. Earl Pruitt
minor_characters.note: Oxygen concentrator. Wanders to feed ducks that aren't there. Lives through Act I only with the gas can (pruitt_alive).

minor_characters.name: Deshawn Pruitt
minor_characters.note: Pruitt's grandson. Owes Braith one. Shows the 1940s cistern in Ch8 (pruitt_cistern).

minor_characters.name: Cpl. Haas
minor_characters.note: Bored, decent checkpoint corporal on the Virginia Street bridge. Bribable with cigarettes; trusts Lolo.

minor_characters.name: Pete Lund
minor_characters.note: HVAC tech squatting in Galena with two kids. Crew if you lower your gun (lunds_stayed). May appear as the Ch8 husk.

minor_characters.name: Rosa Esparza
minor_characters.note: Floor kitchen worker, mother of Mateo (8). Met if you help in the crush; returns in Act III with a filter tip.

minor_characters.name: Maj. Dale Kessler
minor_characters.note: Ironwood commander; holds the Sparks yard after Ch7. At Galena's gate in Ch10; stands down if ruiz_defected or avila_stance=governor (and ironwood_hostility<5).

minor_characters.name: SFC Jim Brandt
minor_characters.note: Leader of the stranded Ironwood recovery detail at the Annex. Ruiz's old squadmate.

ambient_npcs.name: Brother Amos
ambient_npcs.hook: Street preacher at the Virginia Street bridge who counts the dead aloud.

acts.1: Preaches and counts in the ration line.
acts.3: A husk in the ash, or Galena's chaplain if given a blanket/coat.

fates.outcome: Chaplain at Galena; reads the census names on Sundays.

ambient_npcs.name: Lonnie Vance
ambient_npcs.hook: Silver Spur lounge singer in a gold sequined jacket, singing Sinatra in the ration line for crackers.

acts.2: Sings on Carly's Switchboard between dispatches.
acts.3: Sings at Galena, or his voice on an old recording in Two Coats.

fates.outcome: Remembers the crackers; sings 'your song' at the Warm Room.

ambient_npcs.name: 'Salt'
ambient_npcs.hook: Desert hermit in a culvert by the Steamboat hot springs. First person to name the Tallmen: 'They've been watching me since September.'

acts.3: Ch9: frozen dead in his chair, or alive and joining the column if you fed him or left him your flashlight.

fates.outcome: Joins the column (+1).
Found frozen; long tracks around his chair.

ambient_npcs.name: Darlene Okoye-Pratt
ambient_npcs.hook: Stranded long-haul trucker with a reefer trailer of frozen chicken off USA Parkway.

acts.2: Armed and hoarding; requisitioned in Ch5 unless she moves to Mo's.
acts.3: With Mo at the truck stop, or gone.

fates.outcome: Runs the truck stop kitchen with Mo through Act III.

ambient_npcs.name: The Bike Kids
ambient_npcs.hook: A pack of 12-year-olds on bikes who run notes between houses, later for the Switchboard.

acts.2: Switchboard runners; reveal map icons. One dies in the Ch6 sweep unless neighbors were hidden.

fates.outcome: Jaden is killed in the Ch6 sweep crossfire.

ambient_npcs.name: Deputy Cal Lusk
ambient_npcs.hook: Off-duty Washoe sheriff's deputy in pajama pants and a uniform jacket; runs the block watch and the marina water line.

acts.1: Self-appointed rules: one trip per family, dusk curfew.
acts.2: Joins the Authority, or closes his cul-de-sac to strangers if Gil was reported.
acts.3: Shuts his street to everyone and dies there, unless lusk_rep>=1 (then he comes to Galena).

fates.outcome: Comes to Galena; runs the gate watch.

ambient_npcs.name: Ruth Calloway
ambient_npcs.hook: Retired second-grade teacher running a class on yoga mats in the convention center ('FRACTIONS (FOOD)').

acts.2: Moves the class into the Silver Spur.
acts.3: Revealed as the Night Owl in Ch8. Runs Galena's school if a council or the Floor holds.

fates.outcome: Galena school, kids at the census board.

ambient_npcs.name: Pvt. Danny Marsh
ambient_npcs.hook: Ironwood deserter hiding in a 4th Street motel after refusing to clear a house with kids in it.

acts.2: Hide him, turn him in, or send him east.
acts.3: In the column with Ruiz if hidden; otherwise shot by the Remnant at the picket.

fates.outcome: Marches in the column (+1).

ambient_npcs.name: The Night Owl
ambient_npcs.hook: Anonymous radio voice reading the names of the missing every night. Radio only.

acts.2: Carly's rival, then ally on the Switchboard.

ambient_npcs.name: Mr. Tolliver
ambient_npcs.hook: Annex contractor guard who held the gate alone for 92 days, uniform still ironed.

acts.2: Talk him down, relieve him, or shoot him.
acts.3: Comes back with you (+1 column, armed guard), stays at the Annex, or is dead.

fates.outcome: Guards Galena's gate; keeps a new log.

traders.name: Dutch Albertson
traders.personality: Cheerful, cynical 4th Street pawnbroker. Everything has a price.

act_shift.1: Takes cash for a week, then barter only.

hook.detail: If trader_dutch_rep<=-1 he sells your Galena route to the Viaduct Crew (ch04_dutch_ambush).

traders.name: Maureen 'Mo' Kessinger
traders.personality: Gruff, fair truck-stop owner. Hates freeloaders, the Army, and sob stories.

act_shift.2: Taxed by Compact and Ironwood; prices x2.
act_shift.3: Last fuel in the valley; sold for warm bunks at Galena.

hook.detail: Fix her transfer pump for standing credit (+3 rep, free diesel). With Darlene (darlene_with_mo) she survives Act III.

traders.name: Wendell Rourke
traders.personality: Virginia City prospector with three burros (Maisie leads). Storyteller and liar.
traders.voice: Old-West tall-tale cadence; talks to the burros.

act_shift.1: Peavine road; trades candles for stories.
act_shift.2: Canyon; needs an escort; first to sell an Annex rumor.
act_shift.3: River camp; strangest stock, same prices.

hook.detail: Get his burros through the Ch5 canyon; reward: the Annex rumor (annex_known).

traders.name: Annie Tran
traders.personality: Gentle, unbudging librarian running the seed library.

act_shift.3: Her atrium needs Galena heat; becomes a council member in the Warm Room.

hook.detail: Promise a heat line to the library atrium (Ch8). Pays off in the Warm Room epilogue.

traders.name: SSgt. Tyrell Boone
traders.personality: Charming, scared Ironwood supply sergeant selling out the back door.
traders.voice: Easy smile, salesman-soldier. 'Very lost, very available.'

act_shift.3: Remnant prices x3; half his filters are expired.

hook.detail: About half his Act III filters are expired (boone_filters_tested reveals it). Expose him to Ruiz (boone_exposed) and Kessler shoots him; his stock drops as loot.

traders.name: Floor commissary
traders.personality: Generic Silver Spur commissary counter run by Roz's cooks.

act_shift.2: Silver Spur chips honored; prices fall with rep_harbor.
act_shift.3: Closed unless the Floor holds the city.

hook.detail: Spend spur_chip earned from Floor jobs.

generic_speakers.braith: The player (Braith Pearce, 25, ex-USAF F-15E crew chief, A&P mechanic). Lines are short, dry, flight-line shorthand.
generic_speakers.compact_rider: Unnamed Lahontan Compact rider at a checkpoint.
generic_speakers.stranger_mother: Mother at the sealed door in Ch8 (from Sun Valley).
generic_speakers.column: Group voice of the Ch9 column.
generic_speakers.deserter_1: Level extra: Ironwood deserter with Ruiz (Ch7). Draws as generic soldier.
generic_speakers.hollow: An assimilated person (enemy type assimilated_human, in-world 'Hollow'). Speaks only in copied, off-cadence phrases. No portrait; silhouette with no breath plume.
generic_speakers.boot_strippers: Level extra: scavengers stripping boots from the dead on the river ice (Ch9).

authority.name: Truckee Meadows Recovery Authority
authority.pitch: County emergency management + Nevada Guard. Registry, ration cards, sectors. Right that counting keeps people alive; wrong that the count is a lie, and in Act II it ships the valley's stocks west.

harbor.name: The Floor
harbor.pitch: Casino workers, churches and UNR students feeding the city from dead casino kitchens; Silver Spur chips as scrip. 'Here' quietly shrinks to 'us,' and they buy guns.

compact.name: Lahontan Compact
compact.pitch: Fallon and Mason Valley farms and ranches allied with the state bloc; Ross Pearce is Ander's lieutenant. Right that the Directive strips Nevada for California; their blockade starves Reno's care homes.

ironwood.name: Task Force Ironwood
ironwood.pitch: Federal Army battalion-minus from Fort Irwin enforcing the Reconstruction Directive (Act II); the Remnant holds the Sparks yard after Ch7. Tired kids under a contested chain of command; some can be spared or turned (Ruiz).

bridge_boys.name: The Viaduct Crew
bridge_boys.pitch: Laid-off warehouse kids and 4th Street motel residents under the I-80 viaduct. Hungry, armed, scared. Kit runs for them.

annex.name: Tallmen (Dixie Valley Annex)
annex.pitch: Not a faction: the escaped LONG SLEEP subjects. No rep, no dialogue. Unknown number. From Act III they also make Hollows (assimilated_human, assimilated_animal): people and animals they fed on and kept. Reyne is the Annex's only human voice.
